summary.text: Teri Ann Hourihan, a No Labels Party candidate and Phoenix mental health counselor, lost the November 3, 2026 election for governor of Arizona to Katie Hobbs.
She won the No Labels primary 56% to 44% over Hugh Lytle, and her running mate was Angela Harrolle Mohan, a real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Hourihan describes herself in the state voter education guide as an Arizona native, mother and small business owner who has been a licensed professional counselor since 2017 and earned a PhD in 2018.
She named Mohan as her running mate on August 6, 2026.
She received 0.9% of the vote to Katie Hobbs's 55.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Underdog candidate bests well-funded opponent in Arizona's first No Labels gubernatorial primary
